title: Upgrade polymorphic messages to a strict canonical version
instruction: Complete upgrade_message(payload) as a strict note-message migration to version 3. Version 1 has exact required version, type='note', text and optional meta fields; versions 2 and 3 have exact required version, kind='note', body and optional metadata fields. Reject missing, extra, unsupported, boolean-version, empty-body, or wrong-kind inputs atomically. Return exactly version=3, kind, body, metadata. Metadata is a mapping of non-empty string keys to detached JSON-like values, rejecting non-finite numbers, unsupported values, cycles, shared mutable containers, and nesting of ten containers or more. Inputs remain unchanged. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 schema lineage combining tagged version migration, exact shapes, recursive aliases, and detachment.
